svg.title: The 75 percent ATS myth
svg.desc: A quote, "75% of resumes are rejected by ATS", is stamped MYTH. Then two lines: No study behind it, it traces to a vendor gone since 2013. Most resumes are turned down by people, not software.

g.text: No study behind it. It traces to a vendor gone since 2013.
Most resumes are turned down by people, not software.
